notes:
- Sir Chonk drops a Free Perk instead of an ammo cache and 2x points: everyone standing gets a random
  perk they don't have from the map's machines (it doesn't raise the price of your next perk). Have them
  all? You get 1500 points instead.
- Weapon level-ups are a slim card at the right edge (a level badge, a bar that fills, a chip for
  each unlock) instead of the big banner in the middle of the screen.
- New setting: Upgrades Replace Camo (Settings, Game). Turn it off to keep your own camo on upgraded
  guns.
- Prestiging a gun takes its attachments off (they stay unlocked).
- The Drum Mag is the magazine: reloading pulls the drum out and puts a new one in (it used to drop a
  tiny stock mag out from under it).
- Boss health bars don't show through walls any more.
- The Arc Zapper's shot is softer and shorter (its ending used to grate).
